methods.name: RAVE training procedure
methods.description: Training for 3M steps, specifically 1.5M steps for each stage, using Adam optimizer with specified hyperparameters.

methods.name: Realtime Audio Variational autoEncoder (RAVE)
methods.description: Built for high-quality audio representation learning and faster than real-time synthesis. Uses a multiband decomposition of the raw waveform to decrease the temporal dimensionality of the data.

methods.name: Generator
methods.description: Modified version of the generator proposed by Kumar et al. (2019) with alternation of upsampling layers and residual networks, feeding the last hidden layer to three sub-networks: waveform, loudness, and noise synthesizer.

methods.name: Discriminator
methods.description: Exact same discriminator as in Kumar et al. (2019), which is a strided convolutional network applied on different scales of the audio signal to prevent artifacts.
